idea-plugin.name: DORA Register of Information Lint
idea-plugin.description:
24 checks on the register CSV before it reaches the supervisor — LEI check digits, ISO dates and codes, references that resolve

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → DORA Register of Information Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. Offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/dora-register-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/dora-register-lint

action.text: DORA Register of Information Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run DORA Register of Information Lint on the file in the editor
